author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete
GO:0035724 CD24 biosynthetic process
GO:0045222 CD4 biosynthetic process
GO:0035780 CD80 biosynthetic process
GO:0035781 CD86 biosynthetic process
GO:0051542 elastin biosynthetic process
GO:0045210 FasL biosynthetic process
and their regulation children, 
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29735

They should be replaced with the parent terms (has_input specific gene product)
GO:0009101 glycoprotein biosynthetic process
GO:0010559 regulation of glycoprotein biosynthetic process
GO:0010561 negative regulation of glycoprotein biosynthetic process
GO:0010560 positive regulation of glycoprotein biosynthetic process

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1pMNsV7qX_BAESnVowKXJuK3SgKLQZ1mpFPaK4tLPpqk/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
UCL 4 (automatic transfer) - has input added
UniProt 5 (automatic transfer)
MGI 3 (automatic transfer)
PseudoCAP 2

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv

----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
None



Thanks.

author: RLovering
body:
Hi
it would have been nice to have been given information about this before the obsoletions were implemented. At least one of the annotations was missing - it was associated with a miRNA, so I am not sure if more annotations have been changed which I won't be able to find until I get error messages.
Updating these after the automatic transfers have occurred without the annotation spreadsheet makes things more difficult as I won't know without reading the paper what glycoprotein was changed
Thanks
Ruth

author: ValWood
body: Hi @RLovering  was the outstanding annotation resolved. AL the terms appear to be obsoleted

author: RLovering
body: All good, will wait for any future error reports. Thanks Ruth
